title: Coordinate noise probability of a sign flip
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}$. Under the coordinate noise rule that keeps its input sign with probability $(1+\rho)/2$ and flips it otherwise, the probability of obtaining $-x$ from $x$ is $1-(1+\rho)/2$.
